Actively participate in research planning meetings, share meaningful contributions, and help clarify next steps for the team. Support colleagues by responding positively to requests for assistance to achieve optimal department results. Contribute to peer accountability efforts that support department improvement in turnover, retention, and employee engagement.
Service Essential Functions
Coordinate with the PI and team to perform technical laboratory research. Follow technical instructions collaboratively in setting up and conducting experiments, including biological assays, quantitative and qualitative analyses. Share updates on assigned experiments and research outcomes with the team.
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
Maintain records of all tests performed and data collected. Help ensure safe operation of appropriate laboratory equipment. Identify opportunities for corrective action and process improvement, share recommendations, and contribute to meeting department and hospital targets for quality and safety.
Finance Essential Functions
Use resources efficiently and avoid waste of supplies. Evaluate and report on inventory levels. Manage time effectively and prioritize daily tasks. Support department management in product evaluations and utilization of existing products.

Contribute to the development or establishment of new laboratory procedures, including biological assays, quantitative and qualitative analysis. Train in new techniques as they emerge. Seek opportunities to expand learning beyond baseline competencies with a focus on continual development as a researcher. Under direct supervision of the Principal Investigator (PI), the Research Assistant I assists in organizing, tabulating, and analyzing data, and maintains records of data collected.
cond_0466.responsibilities:
People Essential Functions
Attends research planning meetings and provides input to support decision-making and identify next steps. Responds to requests for assistance to support department results. Contributes to department improvement goals around turnover, retention, and employee engagement.
Service Essential Functions
Performs technical laboratory research. Accurately follows technical instruction in setting up and conducting experiments, including biological assays, quantitative and qualitative analyses. Provides updates on assigned experiments and research outcomes to the PI.
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
Maintains records of all tests performed and data collected. Ensures safe operation of appropriate laboratory equipment. Identifies opportunities for corrective action and process improvement and documents recommendations; contributes to meeting department and hospital targets for quality and safety.
Finance Essential Functions
Uses resources efficiently; does not waste supplies. Evaluates and reports on inventory levels. Manages time effectively and prioritizes tasks independently. Assists department management in product evaluations and utilization of existing products.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Contributes to the development or establishment of new laboratory procedures, including biological assays, quantitative and qualitative analysis. Trains in new techniques as they emerge. Seeks opportunities to expand learning beyond baseline competencies with a focus on continued development as a researcher. Completes and updates the individual development plan (IDP) on an ongoing basis.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

Together with the team, you will help organize, tabulate, and analyze data, and support the maintenance of accurate research records.
cond_0531.responsibilities:
People Essential Functions
Actively participate in research planning meetings, share meaningful contributions, and help clarify next steps for the team. Support colleagues by responding positively to requests for assistance to achieve optimal department results. Contribute to peer accountability efforts that support department improvement in turnover, retention, and employee engagement.
Service Essential Functions
Coordinate with the PI and team to perform technical laboratory research. Follow technical instructions collaboratively in setting up and conducting experiments, including biological assays, quantitative and qualitative analyses. Share updates on assigned experiments and research outcomes with the team.
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
Maintain records of all tests performed and data collected. Help ensure safe operation of appropriate laboratory equipment. Identify opportunities for corrective action and process improvement, share recommendations, and contribute to meeting department and hospital targets for quality and safety.
Finance Essential Functions
Use resources efficiently and avoid waste of supplies. Evaluate and report on inventory levels. Manage time effectively and prioritize daily tasks. Support department management in product evaluations and utilization of existing products.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Contribute to the development or establishment of new laboratory procedures, including biological assays, quantitative and qualitative analysis. Train in new techniques as they emerge. Seek opportunities to expand learning beyond baseline competencies with a focus on continual development as a researcher. Complete and update the individual development plan (IDP) on an ongoing basis.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.
cond_0531.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor of Arts or Science in a related field
Preferred Requirements
Prior work experience in a research setting

cond_0643.intro: We are looking for a Research Assistant I to join our team at [Company name masked]. The role involves providing technical research support and performing research experiments in a laboratory or office environment. Under direct supervision of the Principal Investigator (PI), the Research Assistant I assists in the organization, tabulation, and analysis of data, and maintains records of data collected. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the kind of experimental and analytical work it involves.
cond_0643.responsibilities:
People Essential Functions
Actively participates in research planning meetings and provides meaningful contributions that drive decision-making and clearly identifies next steps. Demonstrates teamwork by responding positively to requests for assistance achieve optimal department results. Uses peer-to-peer accountability towards improvement of department score for turnover/retention/employee engagement.
Service Essential Functions
Performs technical laboratory research. Accurately follows technical instruction in setting up and conducting experiments, including biological assays, quantitative and qualitative analyses. Provides updates on assigned experiments and research outcomes.
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
Maintains records of all tests performed and data collected. Ensures safe operation of appropriate laboratory equipment. Identifies opportunities for corrective action and process improvement providing recommendations; contributes to meeting department and hospital targets for quality and safety.
Finance Essential Functions
Uses resources efficiently; does not waste supplies. Evaluates and reports on inventory levels. Self-motivated to independently manage time effectively and prioritize daily tasks. Assists department management in product evaluations and utilization of existing products.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Participation in the development or establishment of new laboratory procedures, including biological assays, quantitative and qualitative analysis. Trains in new techniques as they emerge as appropriate. Seeks opportunities to expand learning beyond baseline competencies with a focus on continual development as a researcher. Completes and updates the individual development plan (IDP) on an on-going basis.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.
